title: page_grant counts an owner answer on an item that triage closed after routing it
why: Coordinator, 13:48 CST Nov 7: page_grant.py prints "not counted: item status is closed" for an answer on an item that triage closed after routing it. So a lane that reads its own answer after the close can never pass the check. Lane review-fix-check-round hit this on item 356 at 13:43 CST. Triage closes at routing (owner, item 316), so every routed answer hits it.
note: Done check: a red test where an answer saved before the close is counted after the close. An answer saved after the close is still refused. The guard's verdict changes, so this is a build lane. Coordinator pick, 13:48 CST Nov 7 (undoable): the lane builds a stale_pages.py check that flags a kept answer on a closed item, not a page_grant change. Cause: triage closed relayed items with no lane and no lastAnswer, skipping the busy-lane path in skills/waiting-page/SKILL.md. Triage repaired items 343, 344, 346, 347, 348 and 356 to that shape at 13:55 CST. Built in #1450 (head 3a774cb3a), with runner 8 to merge (coordinator, 14:19 CST Nov 7). After the merge, triage runs `stale_pages.py --answers` to confirm the repair of items 343, 344, 346, 347, 348 and 356. Also #1455, with runner 8 (coordinator, 14:25 CST). Sighting (lane guard-fix-check-sonnet, 15:05 CST Nov 8): triage closed items 444 and 445 at routing, and page_grant.py on main refused 444 a ("item status is closed"). Triage reopened both with a `lane` field at 15:08 CST, until this step merges.
